messages:
Maya (eng): quick heads-up — we have a 1hr cutoff squeeze at 16:00 PT. can owners call ✅ on version bumps, changelog, and any last cherry-picks? pls list blockers.

Tony R: I have the version bump PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3421. needs a quick sanity review (pkg.json change + build). i can merge once someone ack's smoke results.

Priya (QA): I kicked off the staging smoke run. 2 tests failing intermittently: session-timeout and kvcache-evict. investigating, looks like flaky under high-concurrency.

Maya (eng): thanks. Tony — leave the PR flagged for me to merge after smoke passes. PR title contains the new semver: v0.23.1.

Sasha K: re: cherry-picks — i've ported the runtime small-fix to release branch, pushed branch release/cherry/evict-fix. please review: `git fetch origin && git checkout release/cherry/evict-fix`

ReleaseBot: automated checks: ✅ unit tests passed, ⚠️ integration tests (2 failures), 🔒 security scan queued. See CI: https://ci.redwood-infra/pipelines/9876

Priya (QA): updating the ticket with logs. early hypothesis: batching scheduler + small-fix interplay. running isolated repro now. ETA 18m.

Jorge (docs): docs note — changelog entry needed for the evict tweak and the small breaking behavior of `prefetch_cache`. i'll draft a short blurb and post link.

Maya (eng): checklist for cutoff:
- version bump merged
- changelog entry in PR description
- docs blurb (linked)
- release smoke green (staging)
- security scan no critical findings or mitigation path
- release owners on-call during 30m post-cutover

Eva (eng-oncall): i'm on for the 30m window. if anything degrades push the rollback tag `v0.23.0-rollback` and ping #eng-oncall.

Tony R: smoke now passes in staging. Priya: can you re-run the flaky tests? if green i'll merge and trigger cut.

Priya (QA): re-run complete — green this time. attaching short log: 
```
TestSessionTimeout - PASS
KVCacheEvict - PASS
```

Maya (eng): merging now. merging PR and kicking off final canary rollout (10% traffic, 5m intervals).

ReleaseBot: merge complete. canary rollout started: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with automatic health checks.

Sasha K: tagging the cherry-pick branches as included.

Jorge (docs): changelog draft posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/compare/changelog-v0.23.1. please add any wording tweaks.

Maya (eng): final call — anyone blocking sign-off?

Tony R: all good from my side.

Priya (QA): no blockers. keep monitoring.

Eva (eng-oncall): i'll watch metrics. will escalate if error-rate > 1% for more than 3m.

Maya (eng): awesome — thanks everyone. marking this thread as done once canary completes. :party_parrot:
